more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Monoammonium glutamate is used as a flavour enhancer in food. Its technological role is to strengthen flavours already present in food.
more_info.daily_intake: 30 mg glutamic acid/kg body weight/day, combined glutamates (EFSA, 2017).
more_info.side_effects:
Some estimated food-use exposures exceeded the limit.
High-dose animal neurodevelopmental findings supported it; human dose-response evidence was limited.
